## People don’t ask the AI one question. They have a conversation.

Most tools check whether your brand is mentioned in the first answer. Buyers keep asking: for a shortlist, the downsides, whether to trust you, whether you are worth the price, and which one to buy. You can be named first and still lose the sale four questions later.

## How Threads work

A Thread is one buyer’s conversation with an AI assistant, six questions long. Vouch asks your tracked prompt, then follows up the way a buyer would, and records where your brand is named at each stage. Vouch writes the follow-up questions for your category; these are examples.

## The Vouch Rate

The Vouch Rate is one number from 0 to 100: how far your brand survives in the conversation, and whether the assistant recommends you at the end. Vouch shows it only when at least 2 conversations completed that week.

How the Vouch Rate is scored

6 of 10 conversations ended here. The assistant recommended Rival A and cited three forum threads about slow repairs.
